column1: # Every deviation from the EVA Admin 2019 release, declared.
#   MODIFIED    a release file whose content differs from manifest/originals.sha
#   DELETED     a release file that is no longer present
#   ADDED       a file that is not part of the release
#   GENERATED   an added file produced by a tool, regenerable, not hand-edited
#   ADDED_TREE  a directory of our own scaffolding; every file under it counts as
#               ADDED. Rejected if it overlaps any release path, so it can never
#               be used to hide an edit to EVA Admin source.
# MILESTONE is M0 (setup), M1..M4, or the milestone the change belongs to.
# REASON must say why, not what. "Fixed web.xml" is not a reason.
# Verified by tools/manifest-check.sh, which runs as a pre-commit hook.
